A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-21, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#612; borg-reborn-rs #859, PR #864). One build, four
arms (ctl: the four settings 0, the state before #859; shipped: the PR's defaults, 50/2/3/110; room: room only; recall:
curve only), classes-18 at 300,000 engine turns, 18 starts each (72 cells). Evidence retained, stalls included.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls reported start by start.
Exposure: Recall purchases in ctl below the DL5 gate; if too few, say so and do not expand without the owner.
Primary, per arm: the starts held at DL4 or deeper with gold of 500 or more and no Recall carried at the cap, and the share
that reached DL5 or deeper. Also: Recall purchases and scrolls carried at departure by visit; the "# Town departure room:"
notes (free weight and slots at departure; departures short of the room); stacks stored at the Home per visit and the kinds
carried at departure (variety, #863); deaths with rescued and newly killed pairs; mean max CL and depth, by class.
Directional only: confirmation needs a fresh seed block (#556).
